reason: I already pay an admin to type the receipts into Excel every week. She's behind, sure, but it gets done, and half of what I spend is cash to mechanics with no receipt at all, so a bot reading photos doesn't fix my real gap.
objection: $19 a month for something my admin already does, plus she'd have to move from her Excel file to a Google Sheet, and the cash I hand mechanics never makes it into a Telegram group anyway.
would_change_my_mind: If the free 30 documents caught a duplicate or wrong total on fuel or parts that my admin missed, so I could see it actually saves me money and not just typing.
